biggest_catch: Requires 15 qualifying debit-card purchases per month in each of the first 2 full calendar months plus eStatements enrollment; ATM transactions, cash advances, and person-to-person transfers do not count as purchases. New CSB checking customers only (no CSB personal checking held within the last 12 months).
catches: Open a new Simple Checking for Students account with a $10 minimum deposit.

Make at least 15 qualifying purchases per month using the CSB Debit Mastercard within the first 2 full calendar months after the account is opened and funded; purchases must post within the qualification period.
ATM transactions, cash advances, and person-to-person transfers do not qualify as purchases.
Enroll in eStatements through CSB Online or Mobile Banking within 2 months of account opening.
Available to new Cambridge Savings Bank checking customers only; not available to customers who currently hold or have held a CSB personal checking account within the last 12 months.
Provide verification of identification and present a Student ID or other proof of current student status.
Age rules: 18+ can open online or at any branch; ages 16-17 must visit a branch; ages 14-15 must visit a branch with a parent or legal guardian.

steps: Open a new Simple Checking for Students account with a $10 minimum deposit (online if 18+, or in branch with a parent/guardian for ages 14-17), presenting ID and proof of student status.

Make at least 15 qualifying purchases per month with the CSB Debit Mastercard within the first 2 full calendar months after the account is opened and funded (ATM, cash advance, and P2P transactions do not qualify).
Enroll in eStatements through CSB Online or Mobile Banking within 2 months of account opening.
The $150 bonus is earned after both steps are completed.
